{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Stew|Stew]] | [[Cookbook:Chicken|Chicken]]

'''Chicken and dumplings''' is a traditional American comfort food.

==Ingredients==

===Stew===
* Approximately 2 [[Cookbook:liter|liters]] (2 [[Cookbook:quart|quarts]]) [[Cookbook:Chicken Stock|chicken stock]]
* Approximately 1 [[Cookbook:kilogram|kilogram]] (2 [[Cookbook:pound|pounds]]) cooked boneless [[Cookbook:chicken|chicken]] meat, cut into bite-sized pieces
* 1 [[Cookbook:carrot|carrot]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] into rounds
* 1 [[Cookbook:celery|celery]] rib or ¼ [[Cookbook:celeriac|celeriac]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:bay leaf|bay leaf]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:onion|onion]], chopped
* 1 [[Cookbook:teaspoon|teaspoon]] dried [[Cookbook:thyme|thyme]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]], [[Cookbook:pepper|pepper]], and [[Cookbook:Liquid Seasoning|liquid seasoning]] to taste

===Dumplings===
* 150 [[Cookbook:gram|grams]] (1¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|U.S. cups]]) [[Cookbook:Wheat Flour|all-purpose flour]]
* 1½ teaspoons [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
* ½ teaspoon salt
* 20 grams (1½ [[Cookbook:tablespoon|tablespoons]]) [[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|solid fat]] (such as [[Cookbook:Shortening|vegetable shortening]], [[Cookbook:lard|lard]] or [[Cookbook:butter|butter]])
* 150 [[Cookbook:milliliter|milliliters]] (5 [[Cookbook:Fluid Ounce|U.S. fluid ounces]]) [[Cookbook:milk|milk]]

==Procedure==
# Combine all the stew ingredients in a large pot and bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
# Reduce heat and allow to [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] while you make the dumplings.
# For the dumplings, mix the dry ingredients together and [[Cookbook:Mixing#Cutting|cut in]] the shortening until the mixture is coarse and grainy.
# Add milk and mix just until combined into a dough.
# Drop dough by spoonfuls onto the stew.
# Simmer 5 minutes with the lid off and 15–20 minutes longer with the lid on.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
* You can buy chicken stock in cans or jars if you don't want to make it by hand.
* The stew portion of the recipe is very flexible. You can use whatever vegetables and flavorings you like and have on hand.
* To make it [[Cookbook:kosher|kosher]], use vegetable shortening or [[Cookbook:schmaltz|schmaltz]] for the dumplings, and replace the milk with any [[Cookbook:Vegan Substitutions#Dairy|plant milk]].
